grades.quote: Yet Mac OS X is a UNIX system and so needs to support files with multiple names (created with `link` ) or no names (if still in use when unlinked). To accommodate this, Apple puts any file that is in either of these situations into a special invisible directory with a random number as its name.
grades.reason: 直接说明仍在使用的文件在 unlink 后可以没有名称，并解释 HFS Plus 如何保留这种文件。
仅列出文件系统练习，没有解释 unlink 后为何仍能读取文件。
讨论符号链接引发的 TOCTTOU 漏洞，与 unlink 后继续读取文件无关。

grades.quote: On a POSIX system (such as Linux or Mac OS X), demonstrate a program continuing to make use of an open file after all names for that file have been removed.
grades.reason: 明确指出已打开的文件在所有名称被删除后仍可使用，并提供验证思路，但未解释其底层原因。
